search_text: published ZDI-11-353 ZDI-CAN-1065 HP Managed Printing Administration MPAUploader.dll Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-12-22 CVE-2011-4167 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-4167 9.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Managed Printing Administration'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Managed Printing Administration. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the MPAUploader.dll file. An extended length string can be passed into scripts within the management website on port 80 (the 'uploadfile' multipart form data 'filename' parameter in Default.asp) and ultimately to MPAUploader.dll. As a static stack allocation is used to store the buffer and the string length is not handled properly, a remote attacker may overwrite the stack and ultimately execute remote code. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20566.www2.hp.com/portal/site/hpsc/public/kb/docDisplay/?docId=emr_na-c03128469 ['2011-04-01 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-12-22 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-353/
